content: <thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 183.045 corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.038 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a prominent M+2 peak (~33 % of the base), characteristic of a single chlorine atom. Accounting for one ³⁵Cl (34.969 Da) leaves ≈147.069 Da to be composed of C, H, and O. A composition of C₇H₁₂O (mass ≈147.058 Da) combined with one Cl matches the observed mass within experimental error and satisfies the isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula is C₇H₁₂OCl.
